name: Spaceship 0d9a694c on the 3-uniform tiling k3-003
description: A period-10 spaceship on the 3-uniform tiling k3-003 (touching neighbours), 4 to 10 cells, moving one lattice step every 10 generations (c/10). It runs the same way in the 512 rules from B3/S2456 to B3,6,7,8,9,10/S0,2,4,5,6,8,9,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 254 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
